data.one_liner: A simple to use and lightweight dependency injection library for Dart.
data.what_it_does: It stores instances and builders in a Map internally to act as a dependency injection container. You can register dependencies, singletons, or custom factories and retrieve them later using generic types.
use_when: You need a lightweight dependency injection setup without code generation
You want to register services and look them up anywhere
avoid_when: You need a complex dependency injection framework like Dagger
strengths: Supports both dependencies (new instance each time) and singletons
Lazy loading of instances by default
weaknesses: Requires absolute imports for dependencies to avoid issues
Does not handle complex dependency graphs automatically without manual wiring

alternatives.why_pick_it: A widely used service locator for Dart and Flutter with similar imperative registration.
